sections.title: Identity and execution
sections.intro: Record your own evidence and label its source and limits. Imported text remains an unverified draft.

fields.label: Minimal institutional student reference, not national ID
fields.help: Use only the minimal student identifier requested by your teacher. Do not enter a national ID, password or unnecessary personal data.

fields.label: Teaching group
fields.help: Enter your teaching group. This and the minimal reference form the proposed PDF filename.

fields.label: Exact package identity used
fields.help: Copy PACKAGE_ID.txt from this public package. A name alone does not establish version identity.

fields.label: Project and source/file identity
fields.help: Identify P01 and the exact changed file/diff. Identify any optional work separately.

fields.label: Actual runtime, tools and unavailable components
fields.help: Record actual Node/npm, platform and available tools. For an alternative execution route, record a separate prior AUTHORISATION: teacher=...; date=YYYY-MM-DD; scope=execution; reference=...; replacement=... . This record cannot approve an alternative.

fields.label: Classify every observation: source, model, actual library, browser or pending
fields.help: Per observation use SOURCE, MODEL, REACT_TEST, REAL_BROWSER or NOT_EXECUTED. For the standard completed P01 record include ACTUAL_RECORDED: REACT_TEST and REAL_BROWSER, with locators. A separately authorised replacement is SEPARATELY_AUTHORISED_ALTERNATIVE.

sections.title: Ownership inventory
sections.intro: Record your own evidence and label its source and limits. Imported text remains an unverified draft.

fields.label: List concrete values and their owners
fields.help: Name track, savedIds, search, card disclosure and derived visible sessions/counts. Identify each concrete owner; do not copy a generic local/shared slogan.

fields.label: Distinguish URL/server authority from a client view/cache
fields.help: State whether a value is local selection, URL state, server authority or a client copy. P01 has no persistence or network contract.

fields.label: Name actual consumers and source locations
fields.help: Name toolbar, cards and saved summary and locate their reads/dispatches. The reduced save/count witness is not a measured deep prop chain.

fields.label: Name mount/navigation/reset lifetime requirements
fields.help: Describe the observed mounted lifetime and reset/unmount boundary. Do not infer survival after filtering a card out from a test that kept it mounted.

fields.label: Identify derived values and why they are not stored twice
fields.help: State what can be calculated from fixtures, track, search and saved IDs. Explain why it is not stored again in Context.

fields.label: Individual prediction before editing
fields.help: Record this before editing or executing the chosen transition. Retrospective expectation must not be labelled a prior prediction.

sections.title: P01 implementation and evidence
sections.intro: Record your own evidence and label its source and limits. Imported text remains an unverified draft.

fields.label: Complete, in progress or not executed; declarations are not verification
fields.help: COMPLETE_RECORDED is your declaration, not automatic approval. Preserve a draft while any required implementation or observation remains incomplete.

fields.label: Exact changed file and forbidden-file check
fields.help: Only projects/p01/student/src/state/workshop-state.jsx may change. Record the read-only boundary result and inspect the actual diff.

fields.label: Seed cloning/deduplication witness and evidence class
fields.help: Record input seed, output, clone/deduplication check, actual check name and locator. Pure seed functions alone do not prove mounted provider isolation.

fields.label: Action, previous/next state and invariant
fields.help: Record exact action, previous state, next state and invariant for select/toggle/clear. Two toggles are two events, not duplicate-event suppression.

fields.label: No-op reference result and limit
fields.help: Record reference equality for repeated track selection and clearing an already empty selection. State the tested input domain.

fields.label: Actual shared-consumer witness or explicitly pending
fields.help: Record an actual toolbar/card/summary synchronisation observation, source identity and locator, or leave it explicitly pending.

fields.label: Provider isolation witness or pending; not copied from a pure model
fields.help: Record two actual mounted providers with independent state or the pending qualification. Do not promote two freshly cloned arrays into that result.

fields.label: Search/disclosure owner and lifetime witness
fields.help: Search is owned by WorkshopWorkspace; disclosure is card-local. Record which component stayed mounted and what the observation does not establish.

fields.label: Named baseline/objective/regression results with failure classes
fields.help: For standard final P01 record ACTUAL_RECORDED plus BASELINE: PASS, OBJECTIVE: PASS, REGRESSION: PASS and BUILD: PASS with exact names/log locators. Missing tools/parser/crash are distinct blocks, not expected objective failures.

sections.title: Required state ADR
sections.intro: Record your own evidence and label its source and limits. Imported text remains an unverified draft.

fields.label: Draft or completed ADR, not comparator implementation status
fields.help: The required deliverable is the state ADR, not a completed ranking implementation. Draft can be saved; final field review requires your completed ADR record.

fields.label: Own capstone problem, lifetime and coordination constraints
fields.help: Name your capstone feature, consumers, required lifetime, authority, dependency policy and actual coordination needs.

fields.label: Local, lifted, URL, Context and server authority options as applicable
fields.help: Consider the smallest applicable candidates. The supplied workbench has two implementations, not a tested Redux candidate.

fields.label: Observed characterised behaviour versus flags merely supplied
fields.help: Distinguish observed characterised behaviour, source-supported limits and supplied flags. A boolean or matching signature is not authenticated execution.

fields.label: Required capability gates and evidence/source for each
fields.help: Name required capabilities and cite a specific observation or source for each candidate. These particular candidates are not every possible Context/lifted implementation.

fields.label: State which weights are pedagogical assumptions, not measurements
fields.help: Label every fixed cost as a supplied pedagogical assumption unless separately measured. Do not call line count, assumed distance or render count a maintainability benchmark.

fields.label: One changed assumption, explicit tie or no-candidate case
fields.help: Change one requirement/assumption. Include an explicit tie or no-eligible outcome. Explain effects without inventing measurements.

fields.label: Decision, requirement-linked reasons and rejected alternatives
fields.help: Link the decision and rejected alternatives to requirements. Equal-cost alternatives are not more expensive because a tie-break was used.

fields.label: Untested properties and a falsifiable follow-up check
fields.help: Name one untested property and a falsifiable next check, with its evidence class and conditions.

fields.label: P02 and full comparator optional progress; NOT_STARTED allowed
fields.help: NOT_STARTED is allowed for P02 and full comparator implementation. These are not hidden S10 grading requirements.

sections.title: Bounded Gemini critique
sections.intro: Record your own evidence and label its source and limits. Imported text remains an unverified draft.

fields.label: Actual bounded exchange, pending or separately pre-authorised alternative
fields.help: Standard: one real bounded Gemini exchange. Alternative only with a separate prior teacher authorisation recorded below; this selector cannot grant it.

fields.label: Relevant sanitised prompt only
fields.help: Keep the minimal sanitised prompt used for one claim, not a full solution request or complete conversation.

fields.label: Relevant actual answer extract; not the full conversation
fields.help: Paste the relevant actual response excerpt. Under a prior authorised alternative record the required replacement evidence instead; never invent dialogue.

fields.label: One falsifiable claim
fields.help: State one claim that an independent check could falsify.

fields.label: Independent check, locator, result and evidence class
fields.help: Name the source/test/observation, exact locator, result and limit. Gemini repeating its answer is not an independent check.

fields.label: ACCEPTED / REJECTED / PARTIALLY ACCEPTED / UNKNOWN
fields.help: Select one defined verdict. UNKNOWN is honest uncertainty about the claim, not acceptance of P01 or proof of completion.

fields.label: Correction and limitation; separate prior authorisation reference where applicable
fields.help: Give the correction and limitation. For a Gemini alternative, include AUTHORISATION: teacher=...; date=YYYY-MM-DD; scope=gemini; reference=...; replacement=... .

sections.title: Traceability and reflection
sections.intro: Record your own evidence and label its source and limits. Imported text remains an unverified draft.

fields.label: Locators of actual evidence in this single document
fields.help: Point to captures, snippets or logs included in this single document. A filename alone is not an embedded capture.

fields.label: Explicit unfinished obligations or NONE with a reason
fields.help: For final field review write REQUIRED: NONE only after P01, ADR and required critique are complete. List optional work separately on another line.

fields.label: What changed after the independent check
fields.help: Describe what changed after your independent check and why.

fields.label: Confirm removal of credentials and unnecessary private data
fields.help: Record removal of secrets, full conversations and unnecessary private data. Do not paste credentials to prove that you found them.

sections.title: Declaration and PDF route
sections.intro: Record your own evidence and label its source and limits. Imported text remains an unverified draft.

fields.label: I distinguish my observations from supplied data and have not fabricated evidence
fields.help: Leave unchecked until your review. Import or later content edits clear it. A tick cannot authenticate any observation.

fields.label: PDF not yet exported / exported but unreviewed / actual readable file reviewed
fields.help: Distinguish the not-yet-saved final candidate from an actual readable PDF you inspected. Browser print/export requests do not prove a file was saved.

fields.label: Draft / ready for teacher review / actual private Moodle receipt observed
fields.help: DRAFT or READY_FOR_TEACHER_REVIEW is normal here. Use ACTUAL_MOODLE_RECEIPT_RECORDED only after observing the actual private activity and identify the receipt in evidence_index. This tool does not contact Moodle.
